prompts.red_sky_volcanic: Wide 16:9 children's fantasy game background, hand painted storybook gouache, visible brushwork. Red Sky volcanic foothills camp clearing at gentle warm dusk. Open muted rust-gold dirt and short ochre grass, very wide level empty clearing over middle 80 percent of width, clear unobstructed ground from 45 to 75 percent height for sprite lanes, quiet low-detail lower quarter for UI. Horizon at 38 percent; rosy peach open sky, remote rounded brick-red volcanic peaks and sparse stones confined to far edges. Cozy safe friendly mood. Camp props will be added in game, no tents, fires, characters, text, borders or watermark.
prompts.frozen_north: Wide 16:9 hand painted storybook gouache fantasy game backdrop for Frozen North. No camp furniture, characters, text or border.
